## Downloads

- Fix importing `tweens.gd-tutorial.zip` in Godot's Project Manager, which failed to extract every file in a subfolder. Both ZIPs now include directory entries, which Godot's ZIP import needs ([godotengine/godot#124461](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/124461)).
- The standalone tutorial uses the full Figtree TTF instead of a WOFF2 subset.

The library is unchanged from 0.2.0.

- **Godot addon:** `tweens.gd-0.2.1.zip` includes C# and GDScript sources, stable UIDs, and prebuilt native libraries. Requires Godot 4.7 or later (tested with 4.7.2); C# additionally requires Godot .NET and .NET 8 or later. GDScript-only projects do not require .NET.
- **Standalone tutorial:** `tweens.gd-tutorial.zip` includes the complete tutorial project, export presets and the 0.2.1 addon. Requires Godot .NET 4.7.2 and the .NET 8 SDK or later.
- **Compiled C# package:** `tweens.gd.0.2.1.nupkg`, targeting .NET 8 and .NET 10, with symbols in `tweens.gd.0.2.1.snupkg`.

**Full changelog:** [v0.2.0…v0.2.1](https://github.com/outfox/tweens.gd/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1)
